name: TrimPoint
description: Self-hosted position-ceiling tracker. Set a maximum weight (ceiling) for each holding.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the TrimPoint web interface.

variables.name: Finnhub API key
variables.description: Free key from finnhub.io for live prices. Without it, prices stay at what you enter.

variables.name: Password (optional)
variables.description: Set to require a password to open TrimPoint. Leave blank for open access on your LAN.

variables.name: Session secret
variables.description: Random string (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32) so logins survive restarts. Only needed if you set a password.

variables.name: Notify URL
variables.description: ntfy topic URL, Discord webhook, or generic webhook to ping when a holding crosses its ceiling.

variables.name: Cookie secure
variables.description: Set true only if you reach TrimPoint over HTTPS (e.g. behind a reverse proxy).
